title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: search results match text inside images in Word and PowerPoint files
summary: Pass: the roadmap facts, licensing context and both Restricted Content Discovery configuration routes are supported. The claim that embedded image text is usually the least-reviewed tenant content lacks evidence, and Microsoft publishes differing descriptions of Restricted Content Discovery's exceptions that should be acknowledged.
